name: 主計町お料理 いち凛 (Kazuemachi Oryori Ichirin)

claims.text: Traditional Japanese kaiseki-style kitchen relying on soy sauce and dashi-based seasonings; no gluten-free protocol or dedicated equipment is documented, so cross-contamination with wheat should be assumed.

name: 健康食工房 たかの (Kenkoshoku Kobo Takano)

claims.text: Wheat and soy sauce are listed among allergens used in the kitchen, and there is no gluten-free menu; the food is not celiac-safe.

name: 兼六園 三芳庵 (Kenrokuen Miyoshian)

claims.text: Traditional Kaga dishes such as jibu-ni and kabura-zushi rely on soy sauce and other wheat-containing seasonings; no wheat-free preparation is documented.
